decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith Application Form, Design and Access Statement,  Drawing Numbers 12-045AB001B, 0020, 12-045AL001B received 28/11/12and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the slates to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
description: Re-roofing of Building 32 using synthetic slates to match existing.  Demolition of lean-to bike shed and replacement with prefabricated bike shed
